statement.quantifiers: One SQS on all 52 points; every derived STS must have an explicit resolution, not merely one point or one point orbit.

primary_attestation.version: v1, 2025-03-15; only arXiv version shown on parent-read abstract page
primary_attestation.quote: Find more examples of mcDSQS(v)s, for example, an mcDSQS(38) and an RDSQS(52) (the smallest unknown mcDSQS(6n + 2)s and the smallest unknown RDSQS(6n + 4)s, respectively).

baseline: SQS(52) existence is known. The named open increment is simultaneous resolvability of all 52 derived STS(51), not generic SQS existence. Latest journal wording was inaccessible in the scout screen.
representation: First bounded assay: C52-invariant SQS via independent orbit enumeration/Kramer–Mesner, then SAT for derived resolution at orbit representatives and explicitly transport every resolution. Alternative rotational Z51 plus infinity or F25 x {0,1} plus two infinities only after a concrete obstruction/no-headroom from the first representation.
acceptance: Complete explicit quadruple list plus all 52 labelled resolutions; independent direct triple-universe and resolution checks, intended-reason controls, cross-vendor hostile review and separate priority audit.
scope_limits: A general LKTS theorem is not claimed.
A cyclic-only non-find or UNSAT is not RDSQS nonexistence.
Equivalent code-alphabet consequences require the source theorem, not inference from numerics.
resource_contract: Same <=4 CPU workers, <=8 GiB target RSS, <=1800s between checkpoints; all outputs under lane.
permissions: No deletion, publication, external contact, commit/push, global config, paid fallback or old-engine changes.
